director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter padhenge—cricket ground ki boundary jaise. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare poori pitch ghoomo aur wapas wahin aa jao. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai.
haan samajh gayi

Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Toh ungli kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Is khet ke kone P, Q, R, S, T hain. P par ungli rakho aur har bhuja ka naam lo jaise uski lambai jodte ho. Aksar aakhri bhuja chhootti hai. Jod tabhi poora hota hai jab tum wapas P par pahunchte ho. Yahan tak saaf hai?

director.text: 15 centimetres

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare ka hissa hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 5 cm
5 cm sahi nahi hai. Har bhuja par 5 cm likha hua socho. Ab chhah baar 5 cm jodo. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: picture dikhao
Is aakaar ki 6 bhujayein seedhi karke ek line par: 5 cm, 5 cm, 5 cm, 5 cm, 5 cm, 5 cm; kul lambai kitni Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 30 cm

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: upar 6, side mein 4, neeche 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: 20 centimetre

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Phoolon ki ek kyari triangle jaisi hai, uski bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m hain. Uske kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni lambi baad lagegi?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Yeh kadam samajh aaya?
pata nahi, aap batao
Kyari ke teeno kinaare dekho: 7 m, 9 m, 12 m. Baad in teeno par lagegi. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
haan
Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki do bhujayein ho gayi, teesri abhi baaki hai. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
hmm, achha
Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo — Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai, kyunki baad ko teeno kinaaron par chalna hai, ek bhi bhuja chhoot nahi sakti.
mujhe cricket pasand hai
Cricket ki baat hum is sawaal ke baad karenge.
hindi mein batao na

woh wala ho gaya, aage chalo
Achha. Ab tumhari cricket wali baat: usmein tumhe sabse achha kya lagta hai?
40 cm
Achha, yeh jaankar achha laga. Ek aayat card ki bhujayein ghoomte hue 10 cm, 4 cm, 10 cm aur 4 cm hain. Kinaare par ek baar lace lagani hai. Kitni lace chahiye?

director.text: 28 cm hai na

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki lace kinaare par chalti hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm. Har bhuja jodna hamesha chalta hai. Par aayat ki bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur wahin se ek chhota raasta milta hai. Ab wahi dekhte hain. Ab aage chalte hain.
achha

Is aayat mein upar aur neeche wali bhuja 10 m ki hai, woh lambai hai. Daayein-baayein wali 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. Board par 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Kuch poochna hai ab tak?
haan, samajh aaya
Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 16 m sahi nahi hai. Ek cheenti is aayat ke kone se chalti hai, saath mein meter. Pehle 19 m lambai, phir 8 m chaudai. Ab woh saamne wale kone par hai, aadha raasta: sirf do bhujayein chali. Lambai + chaudai yahin tak hai, chakkar mein bhujayein chaar. Ab isi par ek sawaal.
haan samajh gayi
Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Uska meter kitna dikhayega?
director.card: Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Uska meter kitna dikhayega?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai, kyunki do lambai aur do chaudai: 2 × (19 + 8) = 54 m. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 32 metres
Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 10 aur 6 dono do-do baar aate hain: 10 + 6 + 10 + 6 = 32 m.
haan, woh maine bata diya

Achha. Naya aayat: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum bilkul saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha raasta. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Ab 2 × (lambai + chaudai) lagao. Is aayat ka parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ab 2 × (lambai + chaudai) lagao. Is aayat ka parimap kitna hai?

director.text: 34 metres

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki aadha raasta 12 + 5 = 17 m, aur do baar: 2 × 17 = 34 m. Square ki chaaron bhujayein barabar hoti hain, yahan har ek 6 cm. 6 ko chaar baar jodne se achha, seedha 4 × bhuja. Aur jawab ek lambai hai, toh cm mein aayega, square cm mein nahi. Is varg ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Is varg ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 24 cm hai na
Sahi jawab. Dekho, chaar bhujayein, har ek 6 cm: 4 × 6 = 24 cm, lambai hai isliye cm.
woh wala ho gaya, aage chalo
Theek hai. Iska shuruaati hissa dekhte hain. Ek notebook ka cover aayat hai, 24 cm lamba aur 18 cm chauda. Uske kinaare par ek baar tape lagani hai. Kitni tape lagegi?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Cover aayat hai, toh 2 × (lambai + chaudai) lagao: P = 2 × (24 + 18), kyunki chakkar mein lambai do baar milti hai, chaudai bhi do baar. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Bracket pehle: 24 + 18 = 42 cm, kyunki 42 cm aadha kinaara hai, ek kone se saamne wale kone tak. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
theek hai
Yeh toh aadha kinaara tha. Poore ke liye 2 × 42 kitna hoga?
director.card: Yeh toh aadha kinaara tha. Poore ke liye 2 × 42 kitna hoga?

director.text: 84 centimetres

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, aayat ke chakkar mein lambai aur chaudai do-do baar aati hain. Toh poora jawab: cover par 84 cm tape lagegi. Ek playground aayat hai, 40 m lamba aur 25 m chauda. Uska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ek playground aayat hai, 40 m lamba aur 25 m chauda. Uska parimap kitna hai?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 130 m
Bilkul sahi, kyunki aadha chakkar 40 + 25 = 65 m, poora chakkar 2 × 65 = 130 m. Ek table mat 9 cm lamba aur 5 cm chauda hai. Uske kinaare par ek baar lace silni hai. Kitni lace lagegi?
director.card: Ek table mat 9 cm lamba aur 5 cm chauda hai. Uske kinaare par ek baar lace silni hai. Kitni lace lagegi?

director.text: 28 centimetre
Haan, bilkul theek: lace kinaare par silti hai, 2 × (9 + 5) = 2 × 14 = 28 cm. Ek varg tile ki bhuja 11 cm hai. Tile ka parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ek varg tile ki bhuja 11 cm hai. Tile ka parimap kitna hai?

director.text: 44 cm

Sahi jawab. Dekho, chaar barabar bhujayein: 4 × 11 = 44 cm, aur jawab cm mein. Ab tak bhujaon se parimap nikala. Agle hisse mein ulta: parimap milega, aur usse bhuja nikalni hogi. Saath mein park ke chakkar aur baad ka kharcha bhi. Ab aage chalte hain.
